scope: Query-local time-series candidate families. These families are a methodological extension for demonstration and must be validated experimentally before being treated as final SchemaLens families.

families.name: Raw series baseline
families.purpose: Keep timestamped observations in a direct raw-series representation so every temporal workload has a simple baseline candidate.
families.notes: TS0 is intentionally broad: it is the raw baseline against which specialized temporal representations are compared.

families.name: Time-bucketed raw series
families.purpose: Partition raw observations by series identity and a time bucket for bounded time-range scans.
families.notes: The family activates the need for bucketing; exact bucket width is deferred to physical design/benchmarking.

families.name: Co-located multi-metric series
families.purpose: Keep multiple metrics for the same series/time axis together when the workload reads them jointly.

families.name: Metric-specific / alternate-access projection
families.purpose: Create a temporal projection oriented to one metric or an alternate dimension when the query is not anchored by the canonical series identity.

families.name: Latest-state snapshot
families.purpose: Maintain the most recent state separately when the workload repeatedly asks for the newest observation rather than a history range.

families.name: Rollup / multi-resolution aggregate
families.purpose: Materialize time-bucketed summaries such as hourly or daily aggregates.

families.name: Dimension/group aggregate
families.purpose: Materialize temporal aggregates additionally grouped by a non-time dimension such as category, region, tenant, or device type.

families.name: Tag / dimension discovery
families.purpose: Support discovery of series identities through tags/dimensions without first knowing the series key.

families.name: Model-segment representation
families.purpose: Represent a time series as fitted/model segments when the logical workload explicitly requests piecewise/trend segments rather than raw samples.
families.notes: This is a proposed advanced family. The current demo activates it only from an explicit MODEL_SEGMENTS logical requirement.

physical_modifiers.name: Bucket granularity
physical_modifiers.role: Choose hour/day/week/etc. after range/volume evidence is available.

physical_modifiers.name: TTL / retention
physical_modifiers.role: Apply bounded retention when the logical series has a finite retention requirement.

physical_modifiers.name: Time-series compaction
physical_modifiers.role: Prefer a temporal compaction strategy for append-oriented series.

physical_modifiers.name: Shard / salt
physical_modifiers.role: Mitigate hot partitions when event volume crosses a prespecified threshold.

physical_modifiers.name: Late arrival / backfill handling
physical_modifiers.role: Preserve support for out-of-order or backfilled observations.
